DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。上映について何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with the screening?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 映像の字幕が途中から出なくなりました。最後の説明が理解できませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 字幕が途中から消え最後の説明を理解できなかったと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: The subtitles stopped appearing partway through the video. I couldn't understand the final explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that the subtitles disappeared partway through and you could not understand the final explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの場面までは字幕が見えていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: Until which scene could you see the subtitles?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 人物が入口を開ける場面までは見えました。その後、会話の音声だけになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口を開ける場面まで字幕があり以後は音声のみと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Until the scene where a person opens the entrance. After that, there was only spoken dialogue.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that subtitles were visible until the entrance-opening scene and afterwards only audio remained.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この学習用映像には後半にも字幕があります。表示の設定を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: This learning video has subtitles in the second half too. I'll check the display settings.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 字幕が本来あるなら、私が読み逃したわけではないのですね。確認中は映像を止めてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 読み逃しでないことを確認し設定確認中は映像を止めてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: If there are supposed to be subtitles, then it wasn't that I missed reading them. Could you pause the video while checking?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you did not simply miss reading them, and ask for the video to be paused while the settings are checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、一度止めます。ほかのお客様にも状況を説明してから調整します。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I'll stop it for a moment. I'll explain the situation to the other visitors before adjusting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 再開するとき、字幕が消えた場面より少し前から見直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 字幕が消える少し前の場面から再開できるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: When you resume, can we watch again from a little before the scene where the subtitles disappeared?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the video can resume from shortly before the subtitles disappeared.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この上映では巻き戻せます。入口を開ける場面から字幕を確かめて再開します。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can rewind this screening. We'll check the subtitles and resume from the entrance-opening scene.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。再開後に字幕が見えなければ、その場でお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再開後も字幕が見えなければその場で知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. If I still can't see the subtitles after it resumes, I'll tell you right away.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will report immediately if subtitles are still invisible after resuming.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。調整が終わるまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please wait until the adjustments are complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. Can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見学の集合に来ました。作業もすると思って工具を持ってきたのですが、どうすればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現場見学へ工具を持参したので扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've come for the site-tour meeting. I thought we'd also be working and brought tools; what should I do with them?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese what to do with tools you brought to a site visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日のご案内は見学者向けです。作業参加の指示は受けていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today's event is for visitors. You haven't received instructions to take part in work, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。メールの「現場に集合」を、作業開始だと思ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 集合メールを作業開始と誤解し作業指示は受けていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I mistook “meet at the site” in the email for starting work.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistook the meeting email for a work start and received no work instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この学習用見学では作業をしません。工具は使わず、担当者へ持参したことを知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is no work in this learning visit. Please don't use the tools; we'll tell the person responsible you brought them.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鞄に入れたままにします。見学通路へ持ち込まずに置ける場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 工具を鞄に入れたまま見学通路外で置ける場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll keep them in my bag. Is there somewhere to leave it outside the visitor walkway?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for somewhere outside the visitor route to put the tools while keeping them inside the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待機室の荷物置場を担当に確認します。許可を得るまでは受付で鞄を持っていてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the person responsible about the luggage area in the waiting room. Until permission is given, please keep the bag with you at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。保護具については、見学者向けの説明を受ければいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見学者向けの保護具説明を受ける理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. For protective equipment, I should receive the instructions for visitors, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you should receive the protective-equipment explanation for visitors.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。入場許可と保護具の確認が済んでから、担当者と一緒に移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After entry permission and protective equipment are confirmed, you'll move together with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 工具は出さず受付で待ち、見学者の説明を受けてから同行します。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 工具を出さず受付で待ち見学説明後に担当へ同行すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait at reception without taking the tools out, and accompany the person responsible after the visitor explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep tools put away, wait at reception, and follow the person responsible after the visitor instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。担当者を呼びますので、少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for cooperating. I'll call the person responsible, so please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 硬貨を入金したいです。数えた袋に外国の硬貨が一枚混じっていると気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入金用硬貨袋に外国硬貨一枚が混じると申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to deposit coins. I noticed one foreign coin mixed into the bag I've counted.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that one foreign coin is mixed into your bag of deposit coins.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ入金前ですね。その一枚を日本円の額として数えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: You haven't deposited them yet, correct? Did you count that coin as an amount in Japanese yen?

DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。大きさが似ていたので百円と思って合計しました。表の文字を見たら違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 形状から百円として集計したが文字で相違に気づいたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Its size was similar, so I counted it as 100 yen. I realized it was different when I looked at the writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you counted it as 100 yen because of its shape but noticed the difference from the lettering.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日本円の硬貨と分け、入金する分をもう一度確認しましょう。その一枚の扱いは別の相談になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's separate it from the Japanese coins and check the deposit portion again. How to handle that coin is a separate inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外国の一枚は自分で持ち帰ります。今の合計から百円を引くだけでなく、残りを数え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外国硬貨は保持し単純差引きでなく残りを再集計すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll take the foreign coin home myself. Rather than just subtracting 100 yen from the current total, I'll count the rest again.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the foreign coin and recount the rest rather than simply subtracting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかにも違う硬貨がないか、表示を見て確認してください。無理に機械へ入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the markings to make sure there are no other different coins. Please don't force them into the machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ機械には入れていません。種類ごとに分けてから、円の額だけを書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 機械未投入で種類を分け円額だけ記入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't put them in the machine yet. I'd like to sort them by type and write only the yen amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that nothing has been inserted into the machine and you want to sort the types and enter only the yen amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入金する硬貨の取扱条件も担当へ確認できます。以前の集計メモは修正前として残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also ask the person responsible about the conditions for depositing coins. Please keep the previous counting note as the uncorrected version.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日本円を再集計し、外国硬貨は別に持ち帰ります。確認できた入金額だけ担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日本円再集計後に入金額申告し外国硬貨は持帰ると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll recount the Japanese yen and take the foreign coin home separately. I'll tell the person responsible only the deposit amount I've confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat in Japanese that you will recount the yen before declaring the deposit amount and take the foreign coin home.

DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当窓口で硬貨と集計内容をご相談ください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-004-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please discuss the coins and your count at the appropriate counter. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と二人の鞄を一つのロッカーに入れたいです。料金を一回払えば、途中で片方だけ取り出せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人の鞄を一ロッカーへ入れ途中で片方のみ取り出せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend and I want to put both our bags in one locker. If we pay once, can just one of us take a bag out partway through?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether two people's bags can share one locker and one bag be removed earlier.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらのロッカーは開けるとその利用が終わります。お二人の取り出す予定は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Opening this locker ends that period of use. Do you both plan to collect your bags at the same time?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違います。私は夕方ですが、友人は昼に仕事の書類を出す予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人夕方と友人昼の書類取出しという別予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I'll collect mine in the evening, but my friend plans to take out work documents at noon.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your different plans: your collection in the evening and your friend's document collection at noon.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同時に受け取れないなら、別々に保管する方法を考えられます。まだ入れていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you won't collect them together, you can consider storing them separately. You haven't put them in yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。私だけ鍵を持ったまま出かけると、友人が困ることにも気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未収納で本人だけ鍵を持つと同行者が使えないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Correct. I also realized my friend would have a problem if I went out carrying the only key.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that nothing is stored yet and your companion could not use the locker if only you had the key.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、それぞれの荷物に合う大きさを確認しましょう。空いている所は表示で見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let's check what size fits each person's luggage. The display shows available lockers.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の鞄は小さい方に入ります。友人には必要な書類を先に出してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人小鞄は小型へ入れ友人には必要書類を先に取り出してもらうと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My bag fits in the smaller one. I'll ask my friend to take the needed documents out first.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your small bag will go in a small locker and you will ask your friend to remove necessary documents first.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保管する物を各自で決めてから操作してください。鍵や利用情報も各自でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please each decide what to store before operating the lockers. Keep your own key or usage information too.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一つにまとめず各自で預けます。自分の受取時刻と利用終了の扱いも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 各自保管に変え本人受取時刻と開扉後終了を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll each store our belongings rather than combine them. I'll also check my collection time and that opening ends the use.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will switch to separate storage and confirm your collection time and the end of use after opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。貴重品の置き忘れに気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please be careful not to leave valuables behind when you go out.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 検査前に持ち物を整理したいです。補聴器も外すのか、担当へ確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査前に補聴器を外す必要があるか医療担当への照会を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to organize my belongings before the test. Could you ask the medical staff whether I need to remove my hearing aid too?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for medical staff to confirm whether you need to remove your hearing aid before the test.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検査の種類で確認が必要です。今は補聴器を使って説明を聞けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That needs checking for the type of test. Can you currently hear the explanation using your hearing aid?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。まだ外していません。外すと小さい声が聞き取りにくくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在使用中で未取外しだが外すと小声を聞き取りづらいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I haven't taken it out yet. Without it, quiet voices are difficult to hear.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are currently using it and have not removed it, but soft voices are hard to hear without it.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その点を検査担当へ伝えます。外す指示があった場合の保管も相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the testing staff that. Let's also discuss storage if you are told to remove it.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 専用のケースを持っています。連れの鞄へ入れると、どこにあるかわからなくなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人専用ケースがあり同行者鞄へ混ぜたくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a dedicated case. If I put it in my companion's bag, I might lose track of where it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have your own case and do not want to mix it into your companion's bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人のケースと保管場所を確認できるよう、担当へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the staff so they can identify your case and storage place.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分のケースを示し、外した後の説明は文字でも確認したいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ケースを示し取外し後は文字の説明も希望すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll show my case and say I'd also like written explanations after I remove it.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show the case and request written explanations after removal too.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。今の段階で外さず、担当から個別の案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Don't remove it at this stage; please receive individual instructions from the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に外すか確認し、必要ならケースへ保管して、説明を理解できる方法も頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取外し可否と保管と理解方法を個別担当へ先に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first check whether to remove it, store it in its case if needed, and ask for an explanation method I can understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will first ask the individual staff member about removal, storage and how to understand explanations.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、そのご希望を担当へ引き継ぎます。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, I'll pass those wishes to the person responsible. Thank you for discussing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買った野菜に土が付いていました。ここで洗ってから持ち帰れるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入済み土付き野菜を店で洗えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was soil on the vegetables I bought. Could I wash them here before taking them home?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may wash your already-purchased soil-covered vegetables at the store.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの売場では購入品を洗う対応はしていません。持ち帰る袋はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We don't wash purchased goods in this department. Do you have a bag to carry them home?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 布の袋だけです。仕事の鞄へ入れるつもりでしたが、土を付けたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 布袋のみで仕事鞄を土で汚したくないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only a cloth bag. I planned to put it in my work bag, but don't want soil on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have only a cloth bag and do not want soil to dirty your work bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 鞄とは分けて運べる袋を用意する方法があります。売場の野菜を水場へ持ち込まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: One option is to get a bag to carry them separately from your work bag. Please don't take vegetables from the department to the water facilities.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 洗うのは家で行います。袋を一枚追加で買って、布袋の内側に使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 洗浄は帰宅後とし布袋内側用の追加袋を購入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wash them at home. I'd like to buy an extra bag to use inside the cloth bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wash them after returning home and want to buy an additional bag to line the cloth bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの袋の大きさを確認してください。長い野菜の先が出るかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the size of this bag. The ends of long vegetables might stick out.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入る大きい方にします。口まで閉じて、書類のある鞄とは別に持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 長い野菜も入る大袋を選び書類鞄から分けると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take the larger one that fits. I'll close the opening and carry it separately from the bag containing my documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the large bag that fits long vegetables in Japanese and say you will keep it separate from the document bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。野菜の袋に破れがないかも確認してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please also check that the vegetable bag has no tears before carrying it.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 洗ってもらう注文はせず、追加の袋で包んで仕事の荷物と分けて帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 洗浄依頼を取り下げ追加袋で包み別携行すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't request washing; I'll wrap them in the extra bag and take them home separately from my work belongings.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are withdrawing the washing request and will wrap them in an additional bag and carry them separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。追加の袋はこちらでお会計します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll charge for the extra bag here. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書類を印刷したいです。最後のページが白紙ですが、これも一枚として出るのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: PDF末尾白紙がコンビニ印刷の枚数に入るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to print a document. The last page is blank; will it also come out as one sheet?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the blank final PDF page counts toward the convenience-store printing total.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この機械では選んだページが印刷されます。まだ支払い前ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This machine prints selected pages. Have you not paid yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。全三ページと表示されていますが、必要なのは最初の二ページです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 支払前で全三ページのうち最初二ページだけ必要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. It shows three pages in total, but I only need the first two.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not paid and only need the first two of three pages.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 印刷する範囲を設定できるか、画面の案内を確認しましょう。内容はご自身で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the screen guidance to see whether you can set a page range. Please check the document contents yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三ページ全部を出して後で捨てるのでなく、一ページ目から二ページ目を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 全出力破棄でなく対象一二ページ指定を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than print all three and throw one away afterwards, I'd like to select pages one to two.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to specify pages one and two instead of printing everything and discarding a page.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 範囲を変えた後に、印刷枚数と金額の表示を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: After changing the range, please check the displayed page count and charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二ページになりました。二部必要なので、紙は合計四枚ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要二部なので片面の総枚数四枚と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's now two pages. I need two copies, so that's four sheets in total, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that two copies require four sheets for single-sided printing.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 片面印刷の設定なら四枚です。両面の設定になっていないかも見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: With single-sided printing, it is four sheets. Please also check that it isn't set to double-sided.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 片面二ページを二部にします。白紙末尾を含めず、四枚の表示を確認して支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 片面二ページ二部と範囲枚数金額を照合して支払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll print two copies of two single-sided pages. I'll exclude the blank last page, check the display says four sheets, and pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will compare the range, sheet count and charge for two copies of two single-sided pages before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。取り出した書類を忘れずお持ちください。ご利用ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please remember to take your printed documents. Thank you for using the service.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 番号札のボタンを二度押してしまい、二枚あります。余分な方をどうすればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同用件の受付ボタン二度押しで二枚取ったと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I pressed the numbered-ticket button twice and have two tickets. What should I do with the extra one?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that pressing the reception button twice for the same inquiry gave you two tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今お持ちの番号を確認します。どちらも同じ用件のボタンですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the numbers you have. Were both from the button for the same purpose?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、同じです。紙がすぐ出なかったので、もう一度押しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙出力が遅く同じボタン再押下したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the same one. The paper didn't come out immediately, so I pressed again.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that slow paper output caused you to press the same button again.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで余分な受付を確認します。相談が二つあるから二枚取ったわけではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the duplicate registration. You didn't take two because you have two different inquiries, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 違います。今日の相談は住所の記入方法一件で、同じ順番を二つ持つ必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用件は住所記入の一件で二枠予約ではないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. Today's only question is how to fill in an address, and I don't need two places in the same queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Clarify in Japanese that the only inquiry is address entry and you are not booking two slots.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、この二枚を職員へ見せてください。残す番号をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please show both tickets to a staff member. We'll tell you which number to keep.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 勝手に早い方だけ選ばず、二枚ともお渡しして確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号を自己選択せず二枚とも職員へ渡すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't just choose the earlier number myself; I'll hand over both and have you check.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not choose a number yourself and will hand both to staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認しました。こちらの一枚をお持ちになり、もう一方はこちらで扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've checked. Please keep this one; we'll handle the other.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 残す一枚だけで待ちます。案内された番号を確かめ、余分な呼出しには応じません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定一枚のみ保持し余分な番号へ反応せず待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait with only the one you've told me to keep. I'll confirm the indicated number and won't answer a call for the extra one.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep only the designated ticket and wait without responding to the duplicate number.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。こちらの待合でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for cooperating. Please wait in this waiting area.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ住所へ二箱送りたいです。ひもで束ねれば、一つの荷物として扱えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一住所宛の二箱をひもで束ね一荷物にできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send two boxes to the same address. If I tie them together with string, can they count as one parcel?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether two boxes for one address can be tied together and treated as one parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ宛先でも包装の状態で確認が必要です。まだ束ねていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even for the same destination, we need to check the packaging condition. You haven't tied them yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。上の箱は本で、下の箱は衣類です。二つをひもだけでつなぐつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未結束で本箱と衣類箱をひもだけで連結予定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct. The top box contains books and the bottom box clothes. I was planning to connect the two using just string.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that they are not tied yet and you planned to join a book box and clothes box with string alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つが離れたり、ひもが外れたりしない形が必要です。別々に差し出す方法も相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: They need packaging that prevents separation or the string coming off. You can also discuss sending them separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一つにしたいなら、二箱が入る外箱を用意する案も見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一荷物用の外箱に収める案の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I want to make one parcel, could you also check the option of using an outer box that holds both?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check the option of putting both boxes in one outer shipping box.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外箱を含めた大きさ、重さと内側の動きを確認しましょう。二箱をまとめる外箱はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the size and weight including the outer box, and movement inside. Do you have an outer box that holds both?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外箱は今日は持っていません。二箱のまま出す場合の取扱いも聞いて比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外箱未持参で二個発送の場合も比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't brought an outer box today. I'd like to compare by also asking about handling them as two boxes.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have no outer box and want to compare sending two parcels too.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では二つの場合を先に確認できます。ひもだけの状態で受付できると決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we can check the two-parcel option first. Please don't assume they can be accepted tied only with string.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二箱の扱いを聞き、一つにするなら外箱と緩衝を整えてから持参します。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二個条件を聞き一包装なら外箱緩衝完成後に持参すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask about handling two boxes, and if I combine them, I'll bring them after arranging an outer box and cushioning.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will ask the conditions for two parcels and bring a single package only after completing the outer box and cushioning.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お荷物を拝見して方法をご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll look at the parcels and explain the methods. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この満期の通知と通帳を見ています。二つの金額を足せば、今使える額になるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 定期満期通知と普通預金通帳額を足せば利用額になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking at this maturity notice and my bankbook. If I add the two amounts, is that the amount I can use now?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether adding a time-deposit maturity notice and ordinary-account bankbook amount gives the available amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知がどの預金についてかと、通帳の記録時点を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check separately which deposit the notice concerns and the date of the bankbook record.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通知には定期とあります。通帳は普通預金で、今日の記録とは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知は定期で普通通帳記録は本日とは限らないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The notice says time deposit. The bankbook is for ordinary savings, and the record may not be from today.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the notice is for a time deposit and the ordinary-account record is not necessarily current today.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの状態は担当が照合します。通知だけで普通預金へ移ったとは決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person responsible will compare their respective status. Please don't assume the money has moved to ordinary savings based on the notice alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じお金を二度家計表へ足すかもしれないので、先に対象を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家計で同資金を二重集計しないため対象確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I might add the same money twice to my household budget, so I'd like to identify what each refers to first.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to identify the amounts to avoid double-counting the same funds in your household accounts.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通帳と通知を一緒に示し、金額を確認する目的をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show the bankbook and notice together, and explain why you want to check the amounts.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 使う方法を今決めたいわけではありません。どの額がどこにあるかを整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資金運用の決定でなく所在額の整理が目的と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm not trying to decide what to do with the money right now. I'd like to organize which amount is held where.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your purpose is organizing the location and amounts of funds, not deciding investments.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。現在の状態を確認してから、必要なら取扱いの説明を受けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. After checking the current status, you can receive instructions about handling the funds if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知と普通預金の記録を別に照合し、同じ資金を二度数えず確認結果を家計へ記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料を別照合して重複を避け確認結果のみ家計へ記すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll compare the notice and ordinary-account record separately, avoid counting the same funds twice, and enter the confirmed result in my budget.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will cross-check the documents separately, avoid duplication and record only the confirmed result in your household accounts.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。担当窓口へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. I'll show you to the appropriate counter. Thank you for your inquiry.
